items.source: expressionState - the current expression state (includes the context)
items.translation: expressionState - 当前表达式状态（包含上下文）

items.source: EvaluationException - if any problem occurs evaluating the expression
items.translation: EvaluationException - 如果评估表达式时发生任何问题

items.source: The default implementation throws an IllegalStateException since isCompilable() returns false by default.
items.translation: 默认实现会抛出IllegalStateException，因为isCompilable()默认返回false。

items.source: This method will not be invoked unless isCompilable() returns true.
items.translation: 此方法仅在 `isCompilable()` 返回`true`时才会被调用。

items.source: If you override this method, you must also override generateCode(MethodVisitor, CodeFlow).
items.translation: 如果您重写了此方法，还必须重写 generateCode(MethodVisitor, CodeFlow)。

items.source: Context information about the current expression being compiled is available in the supplied CodeFlow object — for example, information about the type of the object currently on the stack.
items.translation: 当前正在编译的表达式上下文信息在提供的 `CodeFlow` 对象中可用——例如，关于当前堆栈上对象的类型信息。

items.source: If you override this method, you must also override isCompilable().
items.translation: 如果您重写了此方法，还必须重写isCompilable()。

items.source: Generate the bytecode for this node into the supplied MethodVisitor.
items.translation: 将此节点的字节码生成到提供的MethodVisitor中。

items.source: Return the n<sup>th</sup> child under this node.
items.translation: 返回该节点下的第 n 个子节点。

items.source: Return the number of children under this node.
items.translation: 返回此节点下的子节点数量。

items.source: Return the end position of this AST node in the expression string.
items.translation: 返回该 AST 节点在表达式字符串中的结束位置。

items.source: Determine the class of the object passed in, unless it is already a class object.
items.translation: 确定传入对象的类，除非它已经是类对象。

items.source: Return the start position of this AST node in the expression string.
items.translation: 返回该 AST 节点在表达式字符串中的起始位置。

items.source:
Evaluate the expression node in the context of the supplied expression state
and return the typed value.
items.translation: 在提供的表达式上下文中评估表达式节点，并返回其类型化的值。

items.source:
Evaluate the expression node in the context of the supplied expression state
and return the value.
items.translation: 在提供的表达式上下文中评估表达式节点并返回其值。

items.source: Determine if this expression node will support a setValue() call.
items.translation: 确定此表达式节点是否支持 setValue() 调用。

items.source: Return the string form of this AST node.
items.translation: 返回此 AST 节点的字符串形式。

items.source:
Evaluate the expression to a node and then set the new value on that node.
For example, if the expression evaluates to a property reference, then the
property will be set to the new value.
items.translation: 将表达式求值为节点，然后在该节点上设置新值。例如，如果表达式求值为属性引用，则该属性将被设置为新值。

items.source: EvaluationException - if something went wrong trying to determine if the node supports writing
items.translation: EvaluationException - 如果在尝试确定节点是否支持写入时出现问题

items.source: EvaluationException - if any problem occurs evaluating the expression or setting the new value
items.translation: EvaluationException - 如果在评估表达式或设置新值时发生任何问题

items.source: the class of the object if it is not already a class object, or null if the object is null
items.translation: 如果该对象还不是类对象，则返回该对象的类；如果该对象为 `null`，则返回 `null`。

items.source: methodVisitor - the ASM MethodVisitor into which code should be generated
items.translation: methodVisitor - 应生成代码的 ASM MethodVisitor

items.source: obj - the object that the caller wants the class of
items.translation: obj - 调用者希望获取其类的对象

items.source: codeFlow - a context object with information about what is on the stack
items.translation: codeFlow - 一个包含栈中信息的上下文对象

items.source: the value of this node evaluated against the specified state
items.translation: 该节点在指定状态下的评估值

items.source: the typed value of this node evaluated against the specified state
items.translation: 该节点在指定状态下评估出的类型值

items.source: the child count
items.translation: 子计数

items.source: the child node
items.translation: 子节点

items.source: the start position
items.translation: 起始位置

items.source: the end position
items.translation: 结束位置

items.source: The default implementation returns false.
items.translation: 默认实现返回false。

items.source:
The reasoning in each node may be different but will typically involve
checking whether the exit type descriptor of the node is known and any
relevant child nodes are compilable.
items.translation: 每个节点中的推理可能不同，但通常涉及检查该节点的退出类型描述符是否已知以及任何相关的子节点是否可编译。

items.source:
Represents a node in the abstract syntax tree (AST) for a parsed Spring
Expression Language (SpEL) expression.
items.translation: 代表解析后的 Spring 表达式语言 (SpEL) 抽象语法树 (AST) 中的一个节点。

items.source: Determine if this node can be compiled to bytecode.
items.translation: 确定此节点是否可以编译为字节码。

items.source: Evaluate the expression to a node and then set the new value on that node.
items.translation: 将表达式求值为一个节点，然后在该节点上设置新值。

items.source: newValue - the new value
items.translation: newValue - 新值

items.translation: true 如果此节点可以编译为字节码

items.translation: 如果表达式节点允许调用 setValue()，则为 true。
